timing.text: Think of an AI agent at a control desk.
caption: THINK OF AN AI AGENT
AT A CONTROL DESK

timing.text: It sees a goal, then chooses the tool that fits.
caption: SEE THE GOAL.
CHOOSE THE RIGHT TOOL.

timing.text: Then it supplies an action: the exact request for that tool.
caption: SUPPLY AN ACTION:
THE EXACT REQUEST.

timing.text: The tool runs and returns a result.
caption: THE TOOL RUNS.
IT RETURNS A RESULT.

timing.text: The agent reads that result, updates its plan, and continues.
caption: READ THE RESULT.
UPDATE. CONTINUE.
